title: Frontend Crash Prevention — Never-Again Checklist
content:
## Black Screen Prevention Checklist

### GATES (must pass before deployment):
1. HTML title tag — must be the app name, not scaffold boilerplate
2. Auth check — read localStorage SYNCHRONOUSLY via useState initializer, never async useEffect
3. Loading state — render a spinner/indicator before auth resolution so users never see blank page
4. Error boundaries — root-level (ErrorBoundary) + per-route (PanelErrorBoundary) for isolation
5. Static file serving — server.js must have express.static(distPath) with SPA catch-all `app.get('*', ...)`
6. Build verification — `npm run build` must succeed; dist folder must exist at deploy time
7. Asset paths — Vite base config matches deployment URL path

### DIAGNOSTIC PROTOCOL (when black screen detected):
1. curl /health — check backend alive
2. curl / — check HTML renders with correct title
3. Check browser console for JS errors
4. Verify dist folder exists and contains index.html + hashed assets
5. Check env vars: VITE_API_URL, DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL
6. Run pipeline-guardian middleware scan

### ROOT CAUSES FIXED (2026-07-28):
- Title: My Google AI Studio App → Kudbee Fuel Gauge — AI Cost Intelligence
- Auth: async useEffect flash → synchronous useState(() => localStorage.getItem(...))
- Loading: no indicator → spinner with 'Initializing Kudbee Control Tower…'
- Error isolation: 15 per-route PanelErrorBoundary wrappers in App.tsx
